payload.text: Clara's Restaurants, Battle Creek and Lansing Michigan Content on this page requires a newer version of Adobe Flash Player. Clara's On the River (COTR) -(at right) Battle Creek Michigan... A walk through Clara's on the River is a walk through the history of Battle Creek. Each room at Clara's On the River is filled with antiques, stories and scenic views. The patio area is the perfect spot for our wonderful summer entertainment. You will also love to visit and stroll around the river during the holidays and gaze at the International Festival of Lights displays. Then come in and warm up or cool down with a drink. Take a minute or two to peruse our 17 page menu, and enjoy our friendly atmosphere. Banquet rooms and special banquet menus are available! Sunday Breakfast Buffet at COTR is always fun. Visit Clara's on the River, BattleCreek Clara's mobile click here Sign our Guestbook! Clara's Lansing Station (bottom left) - Lansing, Michigan restaurant, located on Michigan Ave., just a few blocks east of the Capital building. The original Clara's Restaurant, founded by Pete Jubeck and still run by the family. Eat in a real train car, or sit in the balcony overlooking the restaurant. A bit of European elegance reflects in the three crystal chandeliers hanging above the main dining area. Brunch tour ! Meet your family or friends, or just have lunch and use our wi-fi while you get a bit of work done. The perfect spot for a date, or for a family reunion. We offer a full Sunday Brunch including breakfast & early "dinner" items.
